card_config.value: Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_set: Booster Pack Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Vol.2 [UEX05BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 <Muichiro Tokito> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
『Once Per Turn』 When this character is chosen by an ability on one of your [Nichirin Sword] affinity cards, it gains "This character cannot be blocked by a character with 3000 or less BP" and "This character cannot be chosen by abilities on your opponent's characters, and it cannot be targeted by 【Snipe】" until the start of your next turn.
[When Played] Choose up to one character with 2500 or more BP on your opponent's front line. It loses 2000 BP until the end of the turn.
[When Attacking] Draw a card. Choose up to one character with 1500 or more BP on your opponent's front line. It loses 1000 BP until the end of the turn.
